discovery_method: kb_gap_audit pipeline + batch L4 (newest-ref picked the 2015 introducing commit 533a6198; manual triage identified cd1f545c/a5fe21a1 as the real fixes) + L4 confirmed

public_upstream.fix_subject: avcodec/rscc: do not leave uninitialized data when the input is too short (Fixes: use of uninitialized memory; repro rscc_short_deflate_heap_disclosure)

oh_source.l4_evidence: rscc.c deflate branch has no 'len < pixel_size' zero-fill (grep zero hits); both upstream fix diffs apply clean

vulnerability.summary: RSCC screen-capture decoder: when the deflate output is shorter than the frame needs, the un-filled tail of inflated_buf is emitted as frame data — uninitialized heap disclosure.
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed; runtime repro path documented (short-but-valid deflate stream; MSan or frame diff)

notes: ffmpeg gap batch; same CWE-908 family as CVE-2026-66038 (lcldec) — the uninit-tail pattern is now a confirmed recurring family in this component

form.type: 信息与隐私泄露类 / 敏感信息泄露
form.attachments: 附件包_CVE-2026-70629.zip, patch.diff, upstream_fix2_a5fe21a.diff, upstream_fix_cd1f545.diff, 上游修复对照.txt

trigger_conditions: RSCC 流 zlib 分支解压输出短于帧需求（len < pixel_size）：rscc.c 无尾部清零，帧尾保持未初始化（上游 cd1f545c/a5fe21a1 以 memset 补零修复）。
attack_path: 产品用 ffmpeg 解码不可信屏幕捕获视频（远程支持/录屏处理场景）：攻击者提供短 deflate 输出的构造 RSCC 流 → 解码帧尾泄露未初始化堆内存。
reproduction_commands: 源级三侧对照：a) 上游 cd1f545c/a5fe21a1 修复（上游样本名 rscc_short_deflate_heap_disclosure）；b) OH rscc.c deflate 分支无 len<pixel_size 清零；c) 与 n7.1.1 逐字节一致、官方清单含 7.1.1、diff git apply --check 通过。运行级路径：合法但短的 deflate 输出，MSan 观测 uninit 或对比零填充差分。
